citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 1:40 PM on 29-July-
2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by knocking on the facility door, calling and texting the phone
number on file, and waiting 30 minutes before departing the facility. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and
records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may
result in enforcement action.
End Section
